title: No registerPaymentClosedHandler for refTypes topup / wallet_topup: unpaid payments never expire and pending orders / wallet top-ups stay open forever
steps: 1) Load apps/web/src/modules.ts and print paymentHookSummary() (tooling/qa/bughunt/topup_admin-db.ts hooks). 2) Read expireStalePayments: it only sweeps refTypes returned by closedHandlerRefTypes() (packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:364-376).
expected: closed handlers for topup and wallet_topup (contract payments-api.md s3.2/s4): expiry/cancel sets topup_orders.status=cancelled (when payment.id is the order's current payment) and wallet_topups.status=expired; expired slip/QR payments are swept.
actual: paymentHookSummary().closed = [order,booking,patient_package,rest_order,reservation,stay,ticket_order] - no topup, no wallet_topup. createPayment passes expiresMinutes:30 (orders.ts:181, wallet.ts:168) but the sweep skips these refTypes, so every unpaid top-up order stays pending_payment indefinitely (admin 'รอชำระ' tab grows), the PaymentPanel still accepts slips after the shown deadline, and cancelPayment() from the shared layer never touches the order.
evidence: runtime: paymentHookSummary {"paid":[...,"topup","wallet_topup",...],"closed":["order","booking","patient_package","rest_order","reservation","stay","ticket_order"],"target":["stay","ticket_order"],"access":["stay","ticket_order"]}; grep registerPaymentClosedHandler packages/modules/topup -> no match
suggestedFix: In services/handlers.ts register registerPaymentClosedHandler('topup', onTopupPaymentClosed) that cancels a pending_payment order whose paymentId === payment.id (status cancelled, failureReason=reason, emit topup.cancelled) and registerPaymentClosedHandler('wallet_topup', ...) that marks a pending wallet_topups row expired/cancelled; add a registerPaymentTargetCheck('topup') that also treats status failed as closed.

title: topup.paid outbox payload has no 'fulfillment' (nor gameName/packageName) so the owner is never told about a new manual-fulfilment queue item
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:214 (emitEvent topup.paid payload) vs packages/integrations/src/events/handlers.ts:262-266 (requires ev.payload.fulfillment === 'manual'); topup.processing carries fulfillment but is in IGNORED_EVENTS (handlers.ts:378)
steps: Pay a manual package order (slip approve or wallet) and inspect events_outbox: the topup.paid row payload is {orderId, number, customerId, price, paymentId}; the integrations handler returns early because payload.fulfillment is undefined.
expected: Owner LINE/email 'คิวเติมมือใหม่ TP-xxxx <game> · <package>' for every paid manual order (payments-api.md s6: emitters include what the message shows).
actual: Handler exits at `ev.payload.fulfillment !== 'manual'`; even if it ran, gameName/packageName would be empty strings (str(undefined) = '').
evidence: orders.ts:214 payload keys vs handlers.ts:265 condition; handlers.ts:65 str() returns '' for undefined; handlers.ts:378 IGNORED_EVENTS includes topup.processing
suggestedFix: Add fulfillment, gameName, packageName, contact to the topup.paid payload (and the same fields + accessKey (deviceId) to topup.fulfilled / topup.failed), or make the integrations handler act on topup.processing.

title: topup.fulfilled / topup.failed payloads omit gameName, packageName, contact and accessKey: customer notification shows empty names and the guest link has no ?k=
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:232, :261, :309 and admin/orders.ts:321 (emitEvent payloads) vs packages/integrations/src/events/handlers.ts:239-259 (reads p.gameName, p.packageName, p.contact; link = /topup/<number> without key)
steps: Fulfil any order and read the notification text built by handlers.ts:245-247.
expected: 'เติมสำเร็จ TP-1234 — RoV · 86 Diamonds' with a link the recipient can open (/topup/TP-1234?k=<deviceId>) and delivery to the typed contact (phone/email) for guests without a customer row (LINE-id contacts).
actual: Text renders as ' ·  เข้าแล้ว' (str(undefined) === ''), customerTarget() gets phone=null for guest LINE-id contacts (customerId null, payload.contact undefined) so nobody is notified, and the CTA /topup/<number> opens the unauthorised (masked, no code) view for guests because k is missing.
evidence: orders.ts:232 payload {orderId,number,customerId,fulfillment,supplierRef}; handlers.ts:242-247 uses p.gameName/p.packageName/p.contact; handlers.ts:65 str() fallback ''
suggestedFix: Include gameName, packageName, contact, accessKey: order.deviceId, price in topup.fulfilled/topup.failed/topup.paid payloads and use withKey(link, p.accessKey) in the handler (pattern: commerce order.paid).

title: createTopupOrder never calls isCustomerBlocked: blocked customers (and guests using a blocked phone/e-mail) can still place and pay top-up orders
steps: Set customers.blocked_at for a demo-topup customer, sign in as them (or use their phone as guest contact where OTP is off) and submit the top-up form.
actual: Order is created and (wallet) fulfilled; only the module's own topup_blacklist is consulted (orders.ts:73).
evidence: grep isCustomerBlocked packages/modules/topup -> no match; core helper exists at packages/core/src/customer/index.ts:302
suggestedFix: After validating fields: if (await isCustomerBlocked(tx, tenantId, { customerId: input.customer?.id, phone: normalizeThaiPhone(contact), email })) return fail(CUSTOMER_BLOCKED_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_BLOCKED_CODE); add the label in labels.ts.

title: Money accepted for a failed order: failOrder() on an unpaid order leaves the payment open and onTopupPaid() silently returns instead of refundRequired, so a later slip/QR payment is marked paid with no refund flag
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:209 (if status !== pending_payment return;), :277-311 (failOrder never cancels the open payment); admin entry: packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts:339-348 (adminFailOrder accepts pending_payment); core target check only treats cancelled/refunded as closed (packages/core/src/payments/targets.ts:46-48)
steps: tooling/qa/bughunt/topup_services-proof.ts failed-then-paid: create slip order (rov 40 coupons) -> failOrder(pending order) -> markPaid(payment) (what slip auto-approve / admin approve does).
expected: Either the payment is voided together with the order (cancelPayment) or markPaid flags the payment: providerPayload.refundRequired, failureReason 'ต้องคืนเงิน: ...', event payment.refund_required (payments-api.md s3.1).
actual: RESULT failed-then-paid {orderStatusAfterFail:'failed', paymentStatusAfterFail:'pending', markPaidError:null, paymentStatus:'paid', refundFlag:null, orderStatusAfterPaid:'failed', events:['payment.paid']} - the customer's money sits on a paid payment attached to a failed order; nobody is notified and no refund list shows it.
evidence: runtime output above; orders.ts:209 returns void (contract requires return refundRequired(reason)); orders.ts:284 paid=false path neither cancels nor refunds the payment
suggestedFix: onTopupPaid: if (!order) return refundRequired('ไม่พบรายการ'); if (order.status !== 'pending_payment') return refundRequired('รายการอยู่ในสถานะ ' + order.status); also verify payment.id === order.paymentId. failOrder on a pending_payment order (and adminCancelOrder) should call cancelPayment(tx, tenantId, order.paymentId, reason, { runHandler: false }); register a registerPaymentTargetCheck('topup') that returns a reason for failed/cancelled/refunded/fulfilled.

title: Out-of-stock after payment: paid handler marks the order failed with refundRequired only in topup_orders.supplier_response; the payment row is never flagged (no payment.refund_required event, paymentRefundRequired() null)
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:251 (return failOrder(...) inside fulfillOrder) and :215 (onTopupPaid ignores fulfillOrder's result, always returns void); failOrder :300-302 sets supplierResponse.refundRequired=true only
steps: topup_services-proof.ts oos-paid: slip order for steam 300 (stock), move all codes to reserved, markPaid.
expected: onTopupPaid returns refundRequired('สินค้าหมด') so markPaid sets providerPayload.refundRequired + failureReason and emits payment.refund_required (owner notification, shared admin payments view).
actual: RESULT oos-paid {paymentStatus:'paid', paymentRefundFlag:null, paymentFailureReason:null, orderStatus:'failed', orderSupplierResponse:{reason:'out_of_stock', refundVia:'slip', refundRequired:true}, events:['topup.failed']}
evidence: runtime output above; orders.ts:215 fulfillOrder(...) result discarded
suggestedFix: In onTopupPaid: const done = await fulfillOrder(...); if (done && done.status === 'failed' && done.paymentMethod !== 'wallet') return refundRequired(done.failureReason ?? 'สินค้าหมด'); keep the module-level flag for the queue UI.

title: onWalletTopupPaid throws when the wallet is frozen, so markPaid (slip auto-approve upload, admin approve, provider webhook) fails with a 500 instead of flagging refundRequired
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/wallet.ts:216 (throw new Error('wallet credit failed: frozen')) and :227; writeLedger :84 returns fail('frozen')
steps: topup_services-proof.ts frozen-wallet-topup: createWalletTopup 5000 (bonus 100), freeze the wallet, markPaid(strict) as the slip auto-approval does.
expected: Payment stays paid and is flagged refundRequired('กระเป๋าถูกระงับ') or the credit is accepted (a frozen wallet should block spending, not incoming money); the upload request succeeds (contract s3: never throw for business refusals).
actual: RESULT frozen-wallet-topup {markPaidThrew:'wallet credit failed: frozen', paymentStatus: undefined} - the whole transaction (slip attach + markPaid) rolls back; the customer sees an upload error and can retry forever while the real transfer is never recorded.
suggestedFix: return refundRequired('กระเป๋าเงินถูกระงับ') (or credit regardless of frozen) instead of throw; same for the bonus credit at :227.

title: createTopupOrder accepts payment methods the shop disabled (promptpay/bankTransfer/wallet off, walletEnabled=false): QR orders get a payment with promptpayId=null and wallet purchases work with the wallet feature switched off
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:96-185 (no enabledMethods()/cfg.walletEnabled check); apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/games/[slug]/actions.ts:12-47 (schema allows all three; contrast wallet/actions.ts:26 which checks enabledMethods)
steps: topup_services-proof.ts method-disabled: settings.payments.enabled all false + no promptpayId/bank accounts, config.walletEnabled=false; submit promptpay_qr, slip and wallet orders.
expected: fail('method_disabled') for each (label exists in labels.ts for the wallet action).
actual: RESULT method-disabled {promptpayDisabled:{ok:true, provider:'promptpay', promptpayId:null}, slipDisabled:{ok:true, provider:'bank_transfer'}, walletDisabled:{ok:true, status:'fulfilled'}} - a crafted POST of the server action (paymentMethod is a plain form field) bypasses the shop's payment settings.
suggestedFix: In createTopupOrder: const methods = enabledMethods(input.settings); if (input.paymentMethod === 'wallet' ? !cfg.walletEnabled : !methods.includes(input.paymentMethod)) return fail('method_disabled','method_disabled'); mirror in the action.

title: OTP-required refusal happens after upsertGuestCustomer: every refused guest attempt (and rate_limited / out_of_stock failures) persists a new customers row
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:82-91 (guest upsert at :86, otp check at :91, rate limit :94, stock :100)
steps: topup_services-proof.ts otp-guest-row: otpRequiredFirstOrder=true, guest order with a fresh phone.
expected: No side effects when the order is refused (checks before writes).
actual: RESULT otp-guest-row {result:'otp_required', guestRowsBefore:0, guestRowsAfter:1} - tenantTx commits because fail() is returned, not thrown; an unauthenticated caller can create unlimited customer rows (CRM pollution) with arbitrary phones/e-mails.
suggestedFix: Move the otpRequiredFirstOrder check (and ideally the rate-limit / stock checks) above the guest upsert, or use a savepoint/rollback for refused orders.

title: Rate limit is skipped entirely when the request has no IP and no customer row (countRecentOrders returns 0), and the 'repeat_ip' risk flag is derived from the mixed customer+IP count
steps: topup_services-proof.ts rate-limit: maxOrdersPerHour=2; signed-in customer -> 3rd order rate_limited (OK); guest with ip=null and no contact -> 4 orders all accepted.
expected: A missing IP (misconfigured proxy / clientIp() null) should fail closed or at least count per contact; the repeat flag should reflect what it names.
actual: RESULT rate-limit {customer:['ok','ok','rate_limited'], guestNoIpNoContact:['ok:guest+no_contact' x4]} - guest orders without contact are blocked by the server action (requires contact), so the exposure is limited to deployments where clientIp() returns null.
suggestedFix: When neither customerId nor ip is known, rate-limit by contact (or refuse); compute repeat_ip from an IP-only count.

title: API fulfilment has no idempotent supplier reference and adminRetryOrder re-submits a 'processing' order: with a real HTTP supplier a retry after a timeout double-tops-up the player
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:223-234 (supplierRef = randomRef('SIM-') per attempt, no supplierProductCode / order number sent), packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts:362-372 (retry allowed for status processing, resets to paid and runs fulfillOrder again)
steps: topup_services-proof.ts api-retry: wallet order on an api package -> fulfilled SIM-C8Z7H5; set status=processing (supplier call in flight / unknown result) -> adminRetryOrder.
expected: Fulfilment keyed by the order number (idempotent supplier order id); a retry first queries the supplier for the existing reference and only re-submits when the supplier says the order does not exist; the adapter has a timeout and records request/response.
actual: RESULT api-retry {firstRef:'SIM-C8Z7H5', retry:{status:'fulfilled', ref:'SIM-XUMDFM', resp:{simulated:true}}} - a second unrelated supplier reference is generated; nothing in supplierResponse links the attempts. Only the simulator exists (provider generic_http has no adapter: grep fetch( in services -> none), topup_suppliers.config is free-form JSON stored in plain jsonb (admin/schemas.ts:111-130) with no secret handling and gamePackages.supplierProductCode is never read by fulfilment.
evidence: runtime output above; orders.ts:225 comment 'Simulated supplier'
suggestedFix: Introduce a supplier adapter interface (submit({ idempotencyKey: order.number, productCode, playerFields }) -> { ref, status }, query(ref)), store attempt history in supplierResponse.attempts, make retry call query() first; keep secrets in tenant_secrets (schema comment) instead of config.

title: Ledger idempotency check runs before the wallet row lock: two concurrent writes with the same idempotency key (admin adjust double-submit) end in a unique-violation 500 instead of duplicate:true
steps: topup_services-proof.ts adjust-double: Promise.all of two adjustWallet() with the same requestKey (what a double-clicked dialog produces).
expected: Second call returns ok({ duplicate: true }) as documented on adjustWallet.
actual: RESULT adjust-double {results:['ok dup=false bal=2100', 'throw:Failed query: insert into wallet_transactions ... (unique violation)'], ledgerRows:1} - balance is correct (constraint saves it) but the admin gets an unhandled error; same for concurrent reconcile/markPaid retries sharing wallet_topup:<id>.
suggestedFix: Lock the wallet first (getOrCreateWallet + lockWallet), then look up the idempotency key; or catch 23505 on insert and re-read the existing transaction.

title: Public order lookup is enumerable: sequential TP-numbers return every order's game, package, price, status, timestamps, masked player/phone and admin-typed failureReason without any proof; /api/topup/feed also answers for tenants without the module
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:357-365 (getOrderByNumber public), :338-354 (toPublicOrder exposes failureReason, paymentMethod), :138 (number = TP-<sequential counter>); apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/topup/orders/[number]/route.ts:16-17; apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/topup/feed/route.ts:5-9 (no runtime.config.modules check)
steps: curl -H 'Host: demo-topup.localhost:3000' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/topup/orders/TP-1001 ... TP-1052 (no cookie, no k); curl -H 'Host: demo-shop.localhost:3000' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/topup/feed
expected: Unauthenticated lookup limited to what the status page needs (status + estimate) or rate-limited / requiring a second factor (contact); feed route 404 on tenants without the module.
actual: TP-1001 -> {status:'fulfilled', gameName:'RoV (Arena of Valor)', packageName:'40 คูปอง', player:'1234****', price:3500, placedAt..., authorised:false}; TP-1052 -> {status:'refunded', failureReason:'out_of_stock', player:'0891****' (first 4 digits of the contact phone for voucher games)}; demo-shop feed -> 200 {items:[]}. A scraper can walk TP-1000..TP-n and reconstruct the shop's full sales ledger (volume, prices, failure reasons) and partial phone numbers.
evidence: curl output in this run (HTTP 200 bodies above); orders.ts:362 matches by number only
suggestedFix: Keep the public lookup but strip failureReason/price and throttle it, or require the contact phone (p=) as a weak proof like reservations; in the feed route return 404 unless runtime.config.modules.includes('topup').

title: adminCancelOrder voids the payment with a raw UPDATE payments instead of cancelPayment(): no payment.cancelled event, no closed-handler path, and failed/expired payments are rewritten without the shared state machine
steps: topup_services-proof.ts cancel-event: create slip order -> adminCancelOrder -> read events_outbox.
expected: cancelPayment(tx, tenantId, order.paymentId, reason, { runHandler: false }) per payments-api.md s3.2 -> payment.cancelled emitted.
actual: RESULT cancel-event {cancel:'cancelled', paymentStatus:'cancelled', events:['topup.cancelled']} - payment.cancelled missing.
suggestedFix: Replace the raw update with cancelPayment(..., { runHandler: false }) and catch PaymentStateError for already-paid payments (refuse the cancel).

title: No way to record a manual refund for a failed PromptPay/slip order: the payment stays 'paid' and the order 'failed' with refundRequired forever (refundPayment is only called on the wallet path), so the refund queue never clears and retry can still re-fulfil a refunded order
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:299 (refundPayment only when paymentMethod === 'wallet'), :300-302 (non-wallet: flag only); packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts has no refund action (grep refundPayment/markRefunded in packages/modules/topup/src/admin and apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/topup -> none); adminRetryOrder :362-367 accepts status 'failed' regardless of the flag
steps: Pay a stock order by slip when stock is empty (SERVICES-06) or adminFailOrder a paid slip order; look for an admin action to mark the refund done.
expected: Admin action 'บันทึกคืนเงินแล้ว' -> refundPayment(tx, tenantId, paymentId, amount, note) + order status refunded (as failOrder does for wallet), and adminRetryOrder refusing orders already refunded.
actual: Only the supplier_response.refundRequired boolean exists; the admin list filter refundRequiredSql (admin/orders.ts:89) can never become false again except by a successful retry, and refunded money is not reflected in the payments table (payment.status stays paid, revenue KPIs count it: topupKpis sums price for paid/processing/fulfilled only, but the payments ledger is wrong).
evidence: code: grep refundPayment packages/modules/topup/src -> only services/orders.ts:299 (wallet branch)
suggestedFix: Add adminMarkRefunded(orderId, note): require status failed + refundRequired, call refundPayment(), set order status refunded + supplierResponse.refundedAt/By, audit topup.refund; make adminRetryOrder refuse status refunded (already) and orders with supplierResponse.refundedAt.
